question: What protective effects does worship of this Bhairavi claim to accomplish?
premises: All diseases are to be destroyed
Supreme or hostile mantras are to be warded off
Both effects are prescribed as outcomes
inference: Worship of this Bhairavi is claimed to destroy all diseases and ward off powerful hostile mantras.
uncertainties: parama mantrān may mean supreme mantras or enemy mantras
plain_english: She should destroy all diseases and ward off powerful hostile mantras.
